text:
Elaine Rivera: Quick heads-up — our nightly link scan flagged ~12 internal links in docs/onboarding-guide.html that 404 in staging. Not a huge outage but these are user-facing steps. Can someone triage who owns that page?
Matt K: I can take a look today. Do you have the scan output?
Elaine Rivera: pasted the shortened findings below. Mostly paths under /runtime/examples and one /api/old-endpoint. Not sure if these were renamed in the recent quickstart cleanup.
link-scan-bot: scan: 2026-03-22T05:12Z — 12 dead internal links found in docs/onboarding-guide.html; examples: /runtime/examples/quick-batch, /api/v1/old-generate. Full report: https://internal-reports.redwood/scans/2943210000
Matt K: thanks. @Irina are you the last editor on onboarding-guide? The page was updated in Feb.
Irina Cho: yeah I touched the quickstart block in Feb when we moved example repos. I didn't update the inline permalinks — my bad. I can patch.
Matt K: if you're editing, small ask: can you switch the broken /runtime/examples links to the new path /examples/runtime/quick-batch and replace /api/v1/old-generate with /api/v2/generate? Then open a tiny PR and tag me for CR.
Irina Cho: will do. Quick sed I ran locally:
```bash
rg "runtime/examples/quick-batch|api/v1/old-generate" -n docs/ && \
sed -i 's@/runtime/examples/quick-batch@/examples/runtime/quick-batch@g' docs/onboarding-guide.html && \
sed -i 's@/api/v1/old-generate@/api/v2/generate@g' docs/onboarding-guide.html
```
Matt K: looks good. If you want, add a short changelog note in the PR body because the endpoint rename could affect integrators.
Irina Cho: good call. I'll include a one-line note and the scan link. Aiming to open the PR before lunch.
Elaine Rivera: thanks both — @docs oncall, if PR lands and CI is green can someone merge (low risk) so staging gets the fix before the next run? :pray:
Matt K: I can merge after your tag, @Irina — but will wait for CI green.
link-scan-bot: update: awaiting PR link (if provided) — will re-run after merge to confirm no remaining dead links.
Irina Cho: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7643 — includes sed changes + changelog line. Tagging @Matt K for review.
Matt K: reviewing now, rapid CR. small nit: move the code sample into fenced block for clarity. other than that LGTM.
Irina Cho: pushed fix for the nit. thanks.
Matt K: CI passed. merging now.
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled.
Elaine Rivera: lovely — thanks team. I'll follow up if anything else shows up.
